QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_39

question.text: The Annual Statutory Reporting by a Cat III AIF typically includes all of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Consolidated PPM/fund-document changes (intimated within 1 month of FYE)
Daily trade blotter for every trade executed

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 351-352 list fund-reporting content that includes fund valuation and performance, leverage, exits, consolidated PPM/fund-document changes within 1 month of financial year end, Investor Charter items, and annual stewardship reporting. A daily trade blotter is not part of the annual statutory reporting items listed in the workbook. The Trap: Options A, B and C are drawn directly from the page 351-352 reporting list. Option D describes an internal/operational record that does not appear in the annual statutory reporting items. Note: The contrast is between the page 351-352 annual reporting items (valuation, performance, leverage, exits, PPM changes, Investor Charter, stewardship) and a daily trade blotter, which is not included in those pages.
